name: Economics-Games.com Tragedy of the Commons
description: Economics-Games.com Tragedy of the Commons is an online teaching game that simulates shared-resource dilemmas. Players jointly manage a common pool (e.g., a fishery or pasture) and observe how individual incentives lead to collective outcomes, based on classic models like those of D. Hazlett.
reputation: Widely used in economics education as a top interactive tool for illustrating common-pool resource problems.
notes: Simple, accessible multiplayer format ideal for classroom or individual demonstration.
